title: Lumbar support and other support mentions
summary: This topic is loosely clustered around seat lumbar support, with positive comments on adjustability and comfort alongside a few complaints that the lumbar cannot be reduced enough, while many other mentions refer to unrelated support topics.

positive.summary: Positive reviews praise lumbar support comfort, vertical adjustability, and how it helps keep occupants positioned in the seat, with a few unrelated compliments about dealer or phone support.

negative.summary: Negative reviews describe the driver seat lumbar area as uncomfortable and say the lumbar support cannot be removed or minimized enough for proper back comfort.

undetermined.summary: Undetermined reviews include ambiguous or context-free mentions of dealer, customer, feature, charging, Android, and electricity support, plus one lumbar complaint that was not assigned a clear overall sentiment.

limitations: The cluster mixes seat lumbar support with unrelated meanings of support such as dealer support, customer support, phone support, Android support, wireless charging support, and electricity support.
Many examples are too brief or lack enough context to determine sentiment confidently.
One lumbar-related complaint appears in the undetermined set, so the sentiment split for seat comfort issues is incomplete.
